$comment: Starter recipe - bulk-import evidence-link junction notes from a CSV. Each row produces one (control, has_evidence, evidence_doc) triple. Generic over any concept ontology (NIST 800-53 controls, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CIS safeguards, ISO 27001 clauses) and any evidence-doc namespace (Evidence/, Audits/, Runbooks/). DIRECTION IS LOAD-BEARING: subject is the CONTROL and object is the EVIDENCE ARTIFACT, so the note reads 'control has_evidence document'. The inverse reading ('document implements control') was published in the GRC guide and yields zero coverage, because the coverage query then finds an evidence document where it expects a concept; see the 2026-08-21 Challenge 45 synthesis. PREDICATE IS FIXED, not templated: coverage counts only has_evidence, so a per-row predicate column would silently produce junctions that exist but never count. Other relationship kinds are legitimate and belong in their own recipe. Map subject_curie to the control's stable CURIE wherever the source has it - matching is by identity, and a junction with only wikilink text detaches when the control note is renamed. reviewer/review_date/status/confidence/expires_at are user_preserve so the review workflow is not clobbered on re-import; note that status must reach 'approved' before a junction counts toward coverage.
